sources.role: published pages the record resolves document headings from
rework register; fix cards and owners

row_schema.standard: the artefact/finding standard, or the conformance rule's standard
row_schema.spec: the artefact/finding spec clause, or the conformance rule's spec
row_schema.subject: the artefact subject key, the baseline subject, or the finding area
row_schema.project: the owning project key; 'unassigned' when the source names none
row_schema.title: the record title; baseline rows render '<rule> (<subject>)'
row_schema.severity: the more severe of the generated finding and its fix package; 'unassigned' is refused for an artefact row
row_schema.owner: fix package apply_to, else finding owner_project, else 'unassigned'
row_schema.fix_card: the register package key that owns the work, else the generated finding id
row_schema.fix_card_resolution: published_package | covered_package | artefact_package | finding_id | declared_package_absent | baseline_key | unresolved
row_schema.standard_id: the generated finding id for this artefact, empty when the standard emits no finding
row_schema.declared_package_key: the package_key the artefact record declares, kept so a dangling declaration stays visible
row_schema.target_phase: owner project ADM phase; a phase-* artefact uses its letter; else 'unassigned'
row_schema.deploy_bound: true only when the row text names an action from migrations 0062-0066 or the migration itself

derivation.absent: status == 'absent', mandatory, and the owner project not archived — the same predicate build_findings uses
derivation.stale: a baseline (rule, subject) absent from the live gap register
derivation.open: a v1 finding with empty resolved_by
derivation.fixed_artefacts: register package key, else covered key, else the generated finding id; a declaration absent from the register is recorded, never silently accepted
derivation.severity: the more severe of the generated finding and the fix package; a package may raise severity, never lower it
derivation.deploy_bound: the not-yet-deployed set is migrations 0062-0066 and the authoring.* family 0066 creates

rows.subject: T7
rows.title: Statement Of Architecture Work — SPEC_V2 slice T7 (docs/SPEC_V2.md §12)
The meetings decision forum is normative and has no construction
Kubernetes is reached directly from ops actions, not through the broker
The live strata_rag toolkit is seeded as draft and can never be called
A missing operation dead-ends instead of opening a tool request
tool.output_schema is never stored or read
Zero-use tools are flagged but never retired, and a schema drift opens no kata
The SOP source review gate is hard-coded to a human
SOP intake has no batch path
The authoring pipeline is an inline converter call, not a procedure job
pm.plan replaces an approved baseline without a change request
The PM's status report output has no producer
Reconciliation compares conveyor to itself; billing_service is never read
Unpriced calls become zero in the billing/reconciliation figure
Untyped, unprojected artefacts and links with no tenant/project consistency
Phase H enforces existence, not exactly one typed outcome
PI backlog is one project's WBS, not the programme's standing backlog
Retro lessons need no evidence and produce no kata candidates
Closure bypasses the closure review and the realisation plan
PMP enforcement is partial: closure requires only the scope baseline
No dev.* action family exists for the nine-step development gate set
A completed eval run pins no instrument digest
No deploy or live-verify gate; ops.rollback is a kubectl undo
The promotion journal cannot replay an architecture contract or its board decision

No publish path can declare a tool's idempotency policy
The kata opens measured but inside the coach's tenant, not tenant kata

contracts_request retires another project's live contract via supersedes_id

The trace chain stops at card/project: no run, step, artefact or evidence end
Trace links are optional and not required at creation for architecture-governed work
An incident that needed no write can never be postmortemed or resolved, starving the improvement loop
The live web shell still exposes only V1's nine destinations; six V2 destinations have no route
Four of the six declared analyse.* actions are missing
T14 closed on source-code evidence although its gate demands live probe and live-call receipts
T8 marked built with zero actions and zero modules; its only evidence is the cadence/tranche migration
T3 closed with the specification itself as its only evidence
No BYO surface: the publishable catalogue is a compile-time seed and no OpenAPI import or MCP discovery action exists
